verdict.rationale: Twilio's docs confirm that SMS can be sent through its Messaging API over HTTPS or SDKs. Receiving SMS is only implied by a community remark about handling incoming SMS. Nothing in the pack documents delivery status callbacks. missing for 10: documented delivery status callbacks (StatusCallback webhooks), first-party docs for receiving inbound SMS on a number via webhook, hands-on corroboration of the send/receive/status flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks

citations.quote: Send messages to customers across preferred channels like SMS, MMS, RCS, and WhatsApp with one API.
You can use the APIs directly over HTTPS or through Twilio SDKs available for several programming languages.
Simply cc'ing an incoming SMS to email requires hosting your own code or a SendGrid account.
